Yongzheng-era River Director who built brush weirs on the Wei River. [External dating, inferred: Yongzheng 3 corresponds to AD 1725-1725 by the Qing reign-year table (Kangxi 1 = 1662, Yongzheng 1 = 1723).]

Zhili Governor-General ordered to copy Hu Baoquan's drainage plan. [External dating, inferred: Qianlong 27 corresponds to AD 1762-1762 by the Qing reign-year table (Yongzheng 1 = 1723, Qianlong 1 = 1736).]
Praised in the commentary for upright integrity. [External dating, inferred: Qianlong 14 corresponds to AD 1749-1749 by the Qing reign-year table (Yongzheng 1 = 1723, Qianlong 1 = 1736).]

Praised in the commentary for upright integrity. [External dating, inferred: Qianlong 6 corresponds to AD 1741-1741 by the Qing reign-year table (Kangxi 1 = 1662, Yongzheng 1 = 1723, Qianlong 1 = 1736).]

Praised in the commentary for integrity and his views on disaster relief. [External dating, inferred: Qianlong 8 corresponds to AD 1743-1743 by the Qing reign-year table (Yongzheng 1 = 1723, Qianlong 1 = 1736).]
Praised in the commentary for upright integrity. [External dating, inferred: Qianlong 17 corresponds to AD 1752-1752 by the Qing reign-year table (Yongzheng 1 = 1723, Qianlong 1 = 1736).]

label.en: Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent

translationRepairs: Na Sutu, of the Daijia clan, courtesy name Xi Wen, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
Nasutu, of the Daijia clan, courtesy name Xiwen, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
那蘇圖 is a single Manchu personal name (Nasutu); 羲文 is the courtesy name Xiwen.

In the third year, Na Sutu memorialized: "Under the Ming, coastal guard posts and garrisons had fallen into decay. Our dynasty abolished those posts and reorganized them into garrisons. In Jiangnan there are garrisons at Jinshan, Zhelin, Qingcun, Nanhui, Chuansha, Wusong, and Liuhe, overseen by the provincial commander stationed at Songjiang.

In the third year, Nasutu memorialized: "Under the Ming, coastal guard posts and garrisons had fallen into decay. Our dynasty abolished those posts and reorganized them into garrisons. In Jiangnan there are garrisons at Jinshan, Zhelin, Qingcun, Nanhui, Chuansha, Wusong, and Liuhe, overseen by the provincial commander stationed at Songjiang.
Manchu personal name 那蘇圖 is romanized as one word.

Na Sutu memorialized: "Rice purchased by Jiangsu, Guangdong, and other provinces is arriving in succession. In counties and prefectures that have not suffered disaster, this year's grain tribute is being fully retained on site, so the Two Jiangs need not fear a shortage of rice.

Nasutu memorialized: "Rice purchased by Jiangsu, Guangdong, and other provinces is arriving in succession. In counties and prefectures that have not suffered disaster, this year's grain tribute is being fully retained on site, so the Two Jiangs need not fear a shortage of rice.
Manchu personal name 那蘇圖 is romanized as one word.
In the twelfth year, when the emperor toured east, Na Sutu accompanied him to Tongzhou and was granted ten thousand taels of silver.
In the twelfth year, when the emperor toured east, Nasutu accompanied him to Tongzhou and was granted ten thousand taels of silver.
Manchu personal name 那蘇圖 is romanized as one word.
He was given the additional title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
He was given the additional title of Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
太子少傅 is Junior Tutor; 太子少保 is Junior Guardian.
Na Sutu requested to go to the Jinchuan front to assist Ban Di in managing affairs; the emperor did not permit it.
Nasutu requested to go to the Jinchuan front to assist Bandi in managing affairs; the emperor did not permit it.
那蘇圖 (Nasutu) and 班第 (Bandi) are single-word Manchu/Mongol personal names.
He was again promoted to left subreader.
He was again promoted to Left Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
左庶子 is the Left Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

Earlier, Governor Jin Qiong memorialized to allow dismissed officials and student scions to reclaim wilderness and report contributions; local officials treated this as profit, searched out surplus cultivated land among the people, supplied seed capital in measured amounts, and reported it as new reclamation.

Earlier, Governor Jin Hong memorialized to allow dismissed officials and student scions to reclaim wilderness and report contributions; local officials treated this as profit, searched out surplus cultivated land among the people, supplied seed capital in measured amounts, and reported it as new reclamation.
鉷 is read hong: 金鉷 Jin Hong.

They jointly memorialized on fictitious contributed reclamation, acreage that should be reduced or exempted, and shortchanging of seed capital to student scions. The emperor ordered exemption of tens of thousands of mu of falsely assessed land, and both Qiong and financial commissioner Zhang Yue were dismissed from office.

They jointly memorialized on fictitious contributed reclamation, acreage that should be reduced or exempted, and shortchanging of seed capital to student scions. The emperor ordered exemption of tens of thousands of mu of falsely assessed land, and both Hong and financial commissioner Zhang Yue were dismissed from office.
Yunnan financial commissioner Chen Hongmou memorialized on its abuses; the order was sent down to Governor-General E Mida and Chaoceng for verification.
Yunnan financial commissioner Chen Hongmou memorialized on its abuses; the order was sent down to Governor-General Omida and Chaoceng for verification.
鄂彌達 is a single Manchu name, Omida.

In a memorial he impeached Jiangxi Governor Yue Jun and prefects Dong Wenwei and Liu Yongxi for favoritism and accepting bribes; Vice Minister A Ligun was dispatched together with Jiangnan canal governor Gao Bin to investigate, and Jun and the others were punished.

In a memorial he impeached Jiangxi Governor Yue Jun and prefects Dong Wenwei and Liu Yongxi for favoritism and accepting bribes; Vice Minister Aligun was dispatched together with Jiangnan canal governor Gao Bin to investigate, and Jun and the others were punished.
阿里袞 is a single Manchu name, Aligun.

At Tongzhou the salt canal project also stopped because of the flood. Wang Yong, minister of the Court of Judicature and Review, and Der Min, censor-in-chief, who were overseeing waterworks, ordered the Tangjia Sluice opened to discharge water.

At Tongzhou the salt canal project also stopped because of the flood. Wang Long, minister of the Court of Judicature and Review, and Dermin, vice censor-in-chief, who were overseeing waterworks, ordered the Tangjia Sluice opened to discharge water.
漋 is read long; 德爾敏 is one Manchu name; 副都御史 is vice censor-in-chief.

He submitted another memorial praising Jiangsu Governor Xu Shilin for his thrift and restraint, Anhui Governor Chen Dashou for his open-mindedness and freedom from rigidity, and Jiangxi Governor Bao Huo for his even temper, while noting that only in Jiangxi were officials lax and the people troublesome, with little being done to set matters right.

He submitted another memorial praising Jiangsu Governor Xu Shilin for his thrift and restraint, Anhui Governor Chen Dashou for his open-mindedness and freedom from rigidity, and Jiangxi Governor Bao Kuo for his even temper, while noting that only in Jiangxi were officials lax and the people troublesome, with little being done to set matters right.
包括 is the personal name Bao Kuo.

In his final memorial he wrote: "My late father was Zhi Huai and my mother was née Ju. She dutifully cared for my grandparents and nursed them through illness for more than twenty years without ever slackening.

In his final memorial he wrote: "My late father was Xu Zhihuai and my mother was née Ju. She dutifully cared for my grandparents and nursed them through illness for more than twenty years without ever slackening.
之淮 is the father's given name; the person is Xu Zhihuai.
He inspected Shuntian, Daming, and Guangping prefectures in Zhili, governing envoy affairs with integrity and diligence.
He inspected Shunde, Daming, and Guangping prefectures in Zhili, governing envoy affairs with integrity and diligence.
順德 is Shunde prefecture, not Shuntian.
He served in turn as Right Commissioner of Transmission and Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, retaining the chancellorship in both appointments.
He served in turn as Right Commissioner of Transmission and Left Assistant Censor-in-Chief, retaining the chancellorship in both appointments.
僉都御史 is Assistant Censor-in-Chief.
When the Qianlong Emperor acceded to the throne, Yin Huiyi was immediately granted the nominal rank of Vice Censor-in-Chief and promoted to Salt Controller of the Two Huai Circuits.
When the Qianlong Emperor acceded to the throne, Yin Huiyi was immediately granted the nominal rank of Assistant Censor-in-Chief and promoted to Salt Controller of the Two Huai Circuits.
僉都御史 is Assistant Censor-in-Chief.
He restored and strengthened the local academy, and scholarly activity flourished.
He renovated the Anding Academy, and scholarly activity flourished.
新安定書院 means renovating the Anding Academy.
In the eleventh year of the Qianlong reign he was made Financial Commissioner of Zhejiang, then transferred to Jiangsu, where Governor An Ning impeached him and he was removed from office.
In the eleventh year of the Qianlong reign he was made Financial Commissioner of Zhejiang, then transferred to Jiangsu, where Governor Anning impeached him and he was removed from office.
安寧 is a single Manchu name, Anning.
He once paid respects at the Donglin shrine to Dao Nan, had the Elementary Learning printed, and distributed it among the literati.
He once paid respects at the Daonan Shrine of the Donglin Academy, had the Elementary Learning printed, and distributed it among the literati.
道南祠 is the Daonan Shrine, not a person named Dao Nan.
Governor Yarhašan memorialized that he be admitted to the local shrine of eminent officials.
Governor Yarhashan memorialized that he be admitted to the local shrine of eminent officials.
Use plain romanization of 雅爾哈善.
His son Jia Quan entered service as a secretary in the Board of Punishments after receiving his juren degree and was twice promoted to bureau director.
His son Yin Jiaquan entered service as a secretary in the Board of Punishments after receiving his juren degree and was twice promoted to bureau director.
嘉銓 is the given name of Yin Jiaquan.
In the forty-sixth year of Qianlong, while the Emperor was touring Baoding, Jia Quan sent his son to submit a memorial asking a posthumous title for Yin Huiyi;
In the forty-sixth year of Qianlong, while the Emperor was touring Baoding, Jiaquan sent his son to submit a memorial asking a posthumous title for Yin Huiyi;
Given name 嘉銓 is one word.

The Emperor further condemned Jia Quan for having written his own chronological biography, in which he recorded bargaining with the Board of Punishments over a delayed execution, addressed grand secretaries as "prime minister," and compiled a record of famous ministers' words and deeds—issuing repeated edicts to rebuke him sharply.

The Emperor further condemned Jiaquan for having written his own chronological biography, in which he recorded bargaining with the Board of Punishments over a delayed execution, addressed grand secretaries as "prime minister," and compiled a record of famous ministers' words and deeds—issuing repeated edicts to rebuke him sharply.
Given name 嘉銓 is one word.
Local custom still favors extravagance; Governor-General De Pei is reforming the people through frugality, and I should do all I can to support him.
Local custom still favors extravagance; Governor-General Depei is reforming the people through frugality, and I should do all I can to support him.
德沛 is a single Manchu name.
An Ning, provincial treasurer of Jiangsu, submitted a detailed memorial on relief work, which the Emperor circulated to all governors-general and governors for review.
Anning, provincial treasurer of Jiangsu, submitted a detailed memorial on relief work, which the Emperor circulated to all governors-general and governors for review.
Same romanization as earlier chunks for 安寧.
His son Rubi, courtesy name Zhenzhi.
His son Wang Rubi, courtesy name Zhenzhi.
汝璧 is Wang Rubi, son of Wang Shu.

Soon, together with Governor-General Ermida and Regional Commander Zheng Wenhuan, he memorialized that boundaries be drawn between Lesser Jinchuan and Zagun and Suomo, returning the six seized villages of Bisaduo to Zagun and Suomo;

Soon, together with Governor-General Omida and Regional Commander Zheng Wenhuan, he memorialized that boundaries be drawn between Lesser Jinchuan and Zagun and Suomo, returning the six seized villages of Bisaduo to Zagun and Suomo;
Same romanization as earlier chunks for 鄂彌達.
He was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
He was made Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
太子少師 is Junior Preceptor; Junior Tutor is 太子少傅.

The Zuo Liang Hall should set deadlines for collection and punishment; if even one bannerman under a transport supervisor had outstanding arrears, merit review should be suspended and bannermen reassigned.

The Grain Receiving Office (Zuoliang Ting) should set deadlines for collection and punishment; if even one bannerman under a transport supervisor had outstanding arrears, merit review should be suspended and bannermen reassigned.
坐糧廳 is an office, not a person or hall name.
Pan Siju memorialized again with a report; the Emperor said: "This year's disaster in Zhejiang—the governor Chang An wished to conceal it; you took on a difficult assignment."
Pan Siju memorialized again with a report; the Emperor said: "This year's disaster in Zhejiang—the governor Chang'an wished to conceal it; you took on a difficult assignment."
常安 is a single Manchu name.
Hu Baozhan, courtesy name Taishu, was a native of She County in Jiangnan.
Hu Baoquan, courtesy name Taishu, was a native of She County in Jiangnan.
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.
Hu Baozhan passed the provincial examination in the first year of Yongzheng.
Hu Baoquan passed the provincial examination in the first year of Yongzheng.
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.
In the sixth year Grand Secretary Zhalang'a and Vice Minister Aligun inspected reclaimed land in Heilongjiang and Jilin Wula, with Hu Baozhan accompanying them.
In the sixth year Grand Secretary Zhalang'a and Vice Minister Aligun inspected reclaimed land in Heilongjiang and Jilin Wula, with Hu Baoquan accompanying them.
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.
Hu Baozhan memorialized: "Zhili has suffered drought and many have fled; I ask that the governor-general proclaim the Emperor's intent so the people remain calm and await relief.
Hu Baoquan memorialized: "Zhili has suffered drought and many have fled; I ask that the governor-general proclaim the Emperor's intent so the people remain calm and await relief.
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.

In the ninth year the Emperor ordered Grand Secretary Neqin to inspect troops in Henan, Shandong, Jiangnan, and other provinces; Hu Baozhan memorialized: "Troops have grown lax; weapons, rations, and horses vary in condition from place to place.

In the ninth year the Emperor ordered Grand Secretary Neqin to inspect troops in Henan, Shandong, Jiangnan, and other provinces; Hu Baoquan memorialized: "Troops have grown lax; weapons, rations, and horses vary in condition from place to place.
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.

Hu Baozhan memorialized: "As winter waters recede, farmers should be urged to drain fields into gullies so land is not long submerged and spring plowing can proceed; locust nymphs should be guarded against in particular."

Hu Baoquan memorialized: "As winter waters recede, farmers should be urged to drain fields into gullies so land is not long submerged and spring plowing can proceed; locust nymphs should be guarded against in particular."
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.
Grand Secretary Fu Heng commanded troops in Jinchuan, with Hu Baozhan accompanying him.
Grand Secretary Fuheng commanded troops in Jinchuan, with Hu Baoquan accompanying him.
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan. 傅恆 is a single Manchu name.
A Henan commoner named Fu Yujun accused Zhang Tianzhong of plotting rebellion; Hu Baozhan was dispatched to investigate; Yujun confessed to false accusation and was sentenced accordingly.
A Henan commoner named Fu Yujun accused Zhang Tianzhong of plotting rebellion; Hu Baoquan was dispatched to investigate; Yujun confessed to false accusation and was sentenced accordingly.
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.
Hu Baozhan joined Qiu Yuexiu in surveying the works and memorialized: "Henan has four trunk channels: the Jia Lu, Huiji, Wo, and Bagou.
Hu Baoquan joined Qiu Yuexiu in surveying the works and memorialized: "Henan has four trunk channels: the Jia Lu, Huiji, Wo, and Bagou.
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.

In the twenty-third year the Emperor said: "Henan's disaster zones have suffered long; Hu Baozhan has spared no effort, has understood My intent, worked tirelessly to provide relief, and revived the poorest people—this is highly commendable!"

In the twenty-third year the Emperor said: "Henan's disaster zones have suffered long; Hu Baoquan has spared no effort, has understood My intent, worked tirelessly to provide relief, and revived the poorest people—this is highly commendable!"
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.
When the works were finished, the Emperor personally composed a stele on Central Plains river control, praising Hu Baozhan and Qiu Yuexiu; the inscription appears in Qiu Yuexiu's biography.
When the works were finished, the Emperor personally composed a stele on Central Plains river control, praising Hu Baoquan and Qiu Yuexiu; the inscription appears in Qiu Yuexiu's biography.
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.
In the twenty-seventh year Hu Baozhan fell ill and asked to resign.
In the twenty-seventh year Hu Baoquan fell ill and asked to resign.
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.
The commentary says: Na Sutu, Xu Shilin, Wang Shu, and Pan Siju were all known for upright integrity, while Yang Chaoceng and Hu Baozhan added diligence and quick competence.
The commentary says: Nasutu, Xu Shilin, Wang Shu, and Pan Siju were all known for upright integrity, while Yang Chaoceng and Hu Baoquan added diligence and quick competence.
那蘇圖 is a single Manchu name; 瑔 is read quan.
Wang Shu wrote on disaster relief and Hu Baozhan was adept at water control; all put the people's welfare first.
Wang Shu wrote on disaster relief and Hu Baoquan was adept at water control; all put the people's welfare first.
瑔 is read quan: Hu Baoquan.
